nodes.label: robots.txt Allow-All (Laravel default)
nodes.rationale: User-agent: * with an empty Disallow permits every crawler; the file is Laravel's shipped default and has not been tailored to the app.

nodes.label: Server-side Merged Verification Queue
nodes.rationale: Merge pending/needs_repair dataset facilities with citizen submissions into a single endpoint so dataset rows and community reports are decided from the same page instead of leaving 1.117 facilities invisible in the verification menu.

nodes.label: Module-level Singleton Composables
nodes.rationale: Cross-page state lives in module-level composables on purpose: useFacilities feeds map, card list and admin dashboard from one array; no external state-management library is used.

nodes.label: Facility Decision Writes Verification Columns Only
nodes.rationale: Marking a facility verified records who/when/note but never touches the five accessibility indicator columns, because there is no field evidence for those indicators; never a mass status update either.
nodes.norm_label: facility decision writes verification columns only

nodes.label: pending Means Never Checked
nodes.rationale: The 2026-10-22 audit found all 1.117 rows pending with verified_at/verification_method/evidence_url empty, so pending genuinely means 'never checked'. Name/category/address completeness must not be treated as evidence of verification, and no mass status migration is allowed.

nodes.label: Status Renders Label and Glyph, Never Colour Alone
nodes.rationale: Accessibility requirement: StatusPill always renders label plus glyph so status is not conveyed by colour alone; --rust is the only accent and must stay off small text on --ink backgrounds for contrast.
nodes.norm_label: status renders label and glyph, never colour alone

nodes.label: Only Verification Checks: PHPUnit, Pint, Vite Build
nodes.norm_label: only verification checks: phpunit, pint, vite build

nodes.label: AksesKita
nodes.rationale: Core premise: before visiting a public facility the question is not 'where is it' but 'can I enter and use it'. AksesKita puts scattered accessibility information into one map, one data schema and one database.

nodes.label: belum Is Not tidak (unknown != no)
nodes.rationale: A facility whose toilet was never inspected must not be treated as having no accessible toilet. Therefore 'belum' never counts as 'available' in filters and lowers the data completeness percentage; database enum defaults to unknown so absent evidence never reads as 'no'.

nodes.label: facilities:import Idempotent Import Command
nodes.rationale: Rows with an existing external_id are not recreated and rows whose verification_status is not pending are skipped, not overwritten; transactions per 200 rows, per-row CSV report, and never deletes data.

nodes.label: verification_events Audit Trail
nodes.rationale: One row per decision for either subject (submission_id or facility_id, both nullable); the old table name was submission_events. It records decisions, not before/after attribute values.

nodes.label: Laravel Session Authentication
nodes.rationale: Cookie-based session auth (not API tokens) with XSRF-TOKEN cookie; the Vue route guard exists only for UX, real enforcement is the auth middleware, and /admin and /verifikasi redirect guests to /masuk.

nodes.label: Single Admin Role Shortcut
nodes.rationale: There is only one role today, so 'admin role' means 'logged in'; add a role column and Gate when a second staff role (verifikator) is actually needed. Marked as a shortcut in app/Models/User.php.

nodes.label: PHPUnit Test Suite (39 tests, 317 assertions)
nodes.rationale: Only PHP is tested (AksesKitaTest, FacilityImportTest, AuthTest, SubmissionTest, VerificationQueueTest plus Laravel examples); there are no Vue tests, e2e tests, JS linter or CI, so a passing PHP suite does not mean frontend changes are tested.

nodes.label: SDG 10 and SDG 11 Alignment
nodes.rationale: Stated as conceptual only: no social impact measurement, user counts or field verification can be claimed.
